accepting.heading: Yes, we're taking new
accepting.body1: If you've been putting off finding a primary care doctor in Vero Beach, or your last one never seemed to have a minute, you can start here. Register online in a few minutes, or call us and we'll walk you through it.

insurance.heading: Will my insurance
insurance.intro: Most likely, yes. We accept most major plans, and we'll confirm your coverage before your first visit so there are no surprises at the front desk.

faqs.q: Are you accepting new patients in Vero Beach?
faqs.a: Yes. Vero Beach Adult Medicine is accepting new adult patients. You can register online or call us at (772) 569-3212.

faqs.q: Who would my primary care doctor be?
faqs.a: Dr. Patricia Stewart, a board-certified internal medicine physician with more than 25 years in private practice and particular expertise in women's health.

faqs.q: Do you have an internal medicine doctor in Vero Beach?
faqs.a: Yes. Dr. Stewart is board-certified in internal medicine, which means primary care for adults: annual physicals, ongoing care for conditions like blood pressure and diabetes, sick visits, and preventive screenings.

We accept most major plans, including Florida Blue, United Healthcare, Cigna, Aetna, Humana, and Medicare. Self-pay is also welcome. Call (772) 569-3212 and we'll verify your specific plan before your first visit.

faqs.q: What should I bring to my first appointment?
faqs.a: A valid photo ID, your insurance card, a list of your current medications and dosages, any relevant medical records or lab results, and a list of questions or concerns you'd like to discuss.

faqs.q: What if I'm sick and need to be seen quickly?
faqs.a: Call or message us in the morning. We make every effort to accommodate same-day visits for urgent concerns. When our schedule is full, virtual care gives you a prompt alternative.

faqs.q: How do I book my first visit?
faqs.a: Start your new patient registration online, book an appointment through our scheduling page, or call (772) 569-3212. You can also text our office.

cta.heading: Ready when you are.
cta.subhead: Register online in a few minutes, book a time, or just call. Whichever is easiest for you.
